item.title: PostgreSQL 18 UUIDv7: Your Indexes Can Finally Breathe
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 brings native UUIDv7 support with 50% index performance improvement. Say goodbye to UUIDv4 fragmentation and get primary keys that are both ordered and unique.
